question: Which preserved electronic filings form one report amendment family at a closed observation boundary, and which complete supported document is effective at that boundary?

inputs.role: Explicit publisher amendment links, current-filing projections, report identity, and closed received-date discovery evidence.
inputs.version_policy: Pin every listing page digest and the received-through convergence result used by one calculation result.

inputs.role: Exact filing bytes, HDR root and amendment assertions, cover-form identity, and document validity.
inputs.version_policy: Pin one accepted whole-document digest for every referenced family node. A changed byte stream creates a new input manifest.

inputs.role: Versioned HDR and cover-form parsing selected by the embedded format version.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the exact dispatch and parser contract version; unsupported formats remain preserved but block selection.

identity.result_key: family_id + observation-boundary input-manifest digest + calculation version
identity.input_manifest: Ordered listing-page digests, convergence evidence, document digests, and parser-contract versions for every referenced node.
identity.method_version: contract_version; a semantic rule change requires a new version and replay.
identity.result_digest: SHA-256 of the deterministic UTF-8 JSON result bytes; the digest identifies this immutable calculation output, not a mutable family row.

ordered_steps: Freeze one closed received-through listing observation, its convergence state, all listing page digests, and all documents referenced by amendment evidence.
Parse listing amends_file and amended_by as immediate-predecessor assertions. Parse HDR original_report_id only as a family-root assertion; it does not identify an immediate predecessor.
Build connected components from explicit amendment assertions. Never group by filing date, file-number order, committee and coverage similarity, or amendment_chain alone.
Choose the unique node with no accepted predecessor as the root and derive family_id as fec:efile-report:<root file number>.

Retain listing and cover-record committee and coverage assertions independently. Validate that they agree within each node and that committee ID, base form type, and report coverage agree throughout the family. Treat an explicit-link compatibility mismatch as a conflict, not as permission to split the family silently.
Reject cycles, branches, missing referenced nodes, multiple roots, multiple leaves, contradictory links, and discontinuous amendment numbers.

Require listing most_recent and most_recent_filing projections to agree with the unique leaf. amendment_chain is corroborating publisher evidence only because observed listings expose it asymmetrically.
Select the unique leaf as effective only after every blocking check passes. Emit null effective_file_number for every blocked state.

decision_states.meaning: The observed family is closed, internally consistent, complete, supported, and has one effective leaf.
Discovery did not converge or a referenced listing or document is absent.
Explicit publisher assertions branch, cycle, disagree, or violate report compatibility.
A referenced document fails exact-byte, HDR, cover, or conservation checks.
The evidence is preserved but at least one required document has no accepted format parser.

invariants: Every original and amendment remains an immutable source document regardless of which leaf is effective.
A larger file number or later filed_date is never sufficient amendment evidence.
A termination filing is a report-family disposition. It does not delete the committee or any other report family.
One later observation that adds an amendment creates a new result; it never mutates or invalidates a prior reproducible selection.
Convenience fields such as amendment_chain and most_recent_filing corroborate explicit links but never repair a missing predecessor or document.
Selection authorizes only downstream projection from the chosen document. It does not determine which money rows count.

output.grain: One immutable result per report-family identity, closed source observation, and calculation version.

publication_states.meaning: An effective document can feed record-family projections.
Wait for a closed listing observation and all referenced evidence.
Expose the conflict for investigation; publish no current money view.
Retain the source artifact and issues; publish no normalized current view.
Retain bytes until an accepted parser version can replay them.

revisions.input_change_policy: Any listing, convergence, document, or parser input change creates a new immutable calculation result. A newly observed successor changes the selected leaf only in that new result.
revisions.method_change_policy: A change to grouping, compatibility, validation, or selection semantics requires a new calculation contract version and parallel replay.
revisions.history_policy: Retain every source document, assertion, issue, result, and selected leaf indefinitely. Never rewrite historical observation-boundary results to the latest family state.

checks.rule: The received-through listing window completed a converged pass; a partial or changing page set cannot select a leaf.
Every file number named by amends_file, amended_by, HDR original_report_id, or the asserted current projection has a captured listing and exact document.
Every node has one accepted exact-byte document digest and supported HDR parser.
The immediate-predecessor graph is acyclic and has exactly one root and one leaf.
No node has more than one predecessor or successor and amendment numbers form one continuous sequence beginning at zero.
Listing and cover committee/coverage assertions agree within each node, and committee ID, base form type, and coverage start/end match throughout an explicitly linked family.
most_recent and most_recent_filing assertions agree with the computed leaf; null predecessor-side amended_by is allowed only at the leaf.
Capture amendment_chain exactly and report asymmetric projections; do not require every listing record to expose the same array.

scenarios: HDR root assertion plus immediate listing predecessor

propagation.no_change_policy: If the complete input manifest and calculation version already have a successful result digest, reuse it and emit no downstream selection change. A source-only observation with the same family semantics may update operational lineage without rebuilding row projections.

use.retention: Retain every result and its complete input manifest indefinitely so an investigative answer can reproduce which document was effective at a stated observation boundary.
use.disclaimer: Effective means the selected complete electronic filing in a supported, closed amendment family as observed by Legal Tender. It does not establish processed FEC acceptance, paper-filing coverage, or a final monetary total.
